entities.summary: Suriya Jungrungreangkit (b. 1954-12-10, Phra Nakhon Province) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Phra Nakhon Province and Thailand. Known in the fields of thailand, merchants & economists, asia.
